mostWorthwhile.text: Building the living bone was most worthwhile: the planned cutaways connect collagen's toughness and mineral's compression resistance with embedded cells and their blood supply.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells was comparatively less engaging on its own; it mainly filled a component already anticipated from the lineage and framework.

surprise.text: The lineage plan showed some matrix-producing osteoblasts becoming embedded osteocytes, making the mature bone's living cells more concrete.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless, though the lineage names mesodermal and mesenchymal precursors without explaining them; their role in the route could be clearer for the intended audience.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how the assembled skeleton connects to muscle and movement, especially if the next chapter continues to link structure with function.
